# Code of Conduct

Everyone participating in RentnerMenu is expected to make collaboration welcoming, respectful, and constructive. This applies to issues, pull requests, reviews, and other project spaces, including interactions when representing the project.

## Expected behavior

- Treat people with respect regardless of background, identity, experience, or ability.
- Discuss ideas and code without personal attacks; accept constructive feedback.
- Respect privacy and consent. Ask before sharing another person's private information.
- Help keep discussions focused and accessible, and give others room to contribute.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized behavior, deliberate intimidation, doxxing, and repeated disruptive behavior are not acceptable.

## Reporting and enforcement

The maintainer, [@RentnerKev](https://github.com/RentnerKev), moderates this repository and may edit or remove harmful content, close discussions, limit participation, or block accounts according to the severity and repetition of the behavior. When practical, the maintainer will explain moderation decisions without exposing confidential reports.

Use GitHub's reporting controls or [report abuse to GitHub privately](https://support.github.com/contact/report-abuse) for sensitive conduct reports. Do not publish private details or evidence in an issue. GitHub handles reports sent to GitHub; this repository does not provide a separate private conduct inbox. For an ordinary moderation request without sensitive details, contact @RentnerKev in the relevant project discussion.

Security vulnerabilities follow the separate [security policy](../SECURITY.md).
